captions.detailed: This 3D model is a classic architect's desk lamp featuring a heavy, circular stepped base in dark charcoal. It has a two-segment articulating arm with dual parallel metal rods and decorative spring-tension coils on each segment. The head consists of a pivoting, light grey conical shade housing a small, cream-colored lightbulb inside.
captions.instruction: Generate a classic architect's desk lamp with a weighted circular base, a dual-segment articulating arm with parallel rods and tension springs, and a pivoting conical lamp head containing a lightbulb.
captions.factory: The lamp is constructed using several parts: a base created from stacked cylinders; a lower arm segment composed of parallel rods, crossbars, and a helical spring modeled as a swept circle along a helix; a middle hinge connector; an upper arm segment mirroring the lower arm's construction; and a lamp head consisting of a hollowed cone (revolved profile), a socket cylinder, and a spherical lightbulb. These components are linked using revolute joints at the base, elbow, and head to allow full articulation.
